name: ai-short-drama-screenwriter
title_zh: 竖屏短剧编剧的节拍器：每集卡点、反转、钩子一次排齐
tagline_zh: 写短剧最怕前3集留不住人、中段注水、结尾烂掉。它把每集的冲突点、反转位、钩子位置按竖屏节奏标好，像给剧本装了心电图。
tagline_en: Struggling to hold viewers past episode 3? It maps conflicts, reversals, and hooks to vertical-screen pacing—like.
desc_en: Use when developing, writing, formatting, reviewing, or revising short-form or vertical drama scripts and their episode structures, characters, scenes, dialogue, conflicts, hooks, reversals, or endings.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的写作建议，而是把短剧的「集-场-节拍」拆成可检查的结构层，逐集核对钩子密度和反转位置。
why_en: Not generic writing tips—it decomposes your script into episode-scene-beat layers, auditing hook density and reversal placement.
limit_zh: 只服务竖屏短剧的叙事结构设计与修订，不生成完整对白或文学性描写；需要你已有故事梗概或分集大纲，它不负责从零脑暴创意。
limit_en: For vertical short-drama structure only—no full dialogue or prose generation. Requires your existing synopsis or episode outline; won't brainstorm.
